Drag chips into slots; drop on a taken slot to swap; drag a placed chip out of the table to unassign. A team with one speaker becomes an iron.

blocks.text: Room COUNT = ceil(people ÷ 9), at least 1 — a room seats eight speakers and a judge, so 13 speakers + 1 judge → 2 rooms. Nobody is placed automatically. Registration carries no role: any chip fits any slot, a placed chip reads SPK in a team and ADJ in the chair, and Start re-roles the chairs in the engine. The Allocator hook only reports drops (place {id, slot} / unplace {id}); the server keeps the draft (draft_allocation) and re-renders — every open owner tab sees the same draft. Start session closes registration and turns the draft into engine rooms.
